name: Sheila Helman
source:
Sheila Helman is a member of the Imperial Family of the Helman Empire, being from the 46th generation of the original Helman Emperor Zanageth Helman. She was born in GI1005 as the daughter of [url=/c97994]Pamela Helman[/url], the rightful wife of the most recent Emperor. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Sheila_Helman]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
